source.title: Forebears Uganda forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to seed localized Ugandan given names and surnames. Gender buckets remain sample-level because they are not sourced from an official civil registry.

source.title: ITU Operational Bulletin 1344: Uganda national numbering plan communication of 13.VII.2026

phones.notes: ITU/UCC confirms country code +256, fixed nine-digit national significant numbers, and the listed mobile allocations. Narrower published ranges such as 721000000-721099999, 728000000-728099999, 734000000-734099999 and 737000000-737199999 are omitted because the current prefix generator cannot constrain the remaining subscriber digits. Generated numbers are synthetic and are not checked for live assignment or portability.

locations.notes: UPU confirms Uganda uses five-digit postcodes to the left of the locality and provides Kampala and Nabbingo examples. Kampala prefixes preserve public example stems; other city prefixes remain synthetic placeholders for generator consistency and are not full postal-code validation.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: PRADO Uganda ordinary passport document entry

passport.notes: PRADO confirms the Uganda ordinary passport document family, while the official passport portal confirms current passport application services. No public passport-number grammar was confirmed, so the B plus seven digits template remains an unconfirmed synthetic placeholder.

national_identification_number.label: National Identification Number

source.title: Uganda Registration of Persons Act 2015, sections 68-69

national_identification_number.notes: Uganda law confirms allocation of a unique national identification number and issuance of a national identification card, but no official public number grammar, checksum or semantic digit rule was found. The CM plus twelve digits template remains an unconfirmed synthetic placeholder.
